nodes.label: Agent packages release runbook
nodes.rationale: Public npm + Packagist; the agent plugin ships straight from git main with no npm publish step. Package data/*.json is generated and gitignored so it cannot drift from src/ or leak environment values into git.

nodes.label: npm OIDC Trusted Publishing (two-phase auth)
nodes.rationale: A Trusted Publisher can only be created after the package exists on npm, so the first publish of each package needs a token and OIDC takes over afterward. OIDC needs npm ≥11.5.1, which the pinned Node 22.14.0 does not bundle — hence the explicit global npm upgrade in the job.

nodes.label: scripts/auto-release.mjs (content-fingerprint publishing)
nodes.rationale: Publishes only packages whose built output actually changed, so an unrelated monorepo change does not churn every package. Stateless — the npm registry is the source of truth, so no version-bump commit is pushed to the protected branch; a version conflict is treated as already done.

nodes.label: php-split subtree mirror → Packagist
nodes.rationale: Composer cannot install a package living in a monorepo subdirectory, so the release subtree-splits packages/sdk-php into a read-only mirror. The gitignored sdk-surface.json must be committed into the ephemeral checkout before splitting or the mirror ships without its runtime asset.

nodes.label: CI workflow isolation (php-sdk as its own status check)
nodes.rationale: Branch protection requires only the Web + JS/TS check so a PHP failure never blocks the dev → main merge that gates the npm release; the PHP job downloads the baked sdk-surface artifact because it is gitignored and never built on the PHP runner. CI never publishes.
